europe_now.title: Crimean Bridge Partly Collapses After Ukraine Attack
europe_now.summary: A section of the Crimean Bridge collapsed following an attack praised by Ukraine's president as unprecedented. Zelensky welcomed the strike on the bridge.

sources.headline: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine

europe_now.title: Kosovo Ex-Leader Convicted Again in The Hague
europe_now.summary: Hashim Thaci has been convicted a second time by the Kosovo Specialist Chambers in The Hague. The decision has renewed debate in Kosovo over justice and the role of the court.

sources.headline: Hashim Thaci's second conviction in The Hague reignites debate in Kosovo about justice and the Kosovo Specialist Chambers

top_stories.title: Diplomatic Tensions Over Ukraine Strikes
top_stories.summary: The United States has criticized Ukraine for carrying out deep strikes into Russia as new peace talks approach. Russia's foreign minister said French troops fighting in Ukraine would be seen as direct involvement in the conflict.

sources.headline: US scolds Ukraine over deep strikes ahead of fresh Russia peace talks
Russia’s Lavrov says French troops in Ukraine amount to ‘direct participation’ in war

top_stories.title: French Public-Sector Strikes and Presidential Race
top_stories.summary: More than 140,000 people demonstrated across France in the latest cost-of-living protests. Public-sector workers are demanding better salaries while moderate candidates remain divided and trailing in the French presidential race.

sources.headline: Latest cost-of-living protests bring more than 140,000 onto the streets across France
The centre cannot hold? Splintered moderates lag in French presidential race

top_stories.title: EU Migration Hub and Asylum Centre Proposals
top_stories.summary: Uganda is in talks to host an EU migration hub. The EU's asylum agency has proposed using foreign processing centres to handle asylum claims.

sources.headline: Uganda in talks to host EU migration hub
